name: Transferred News Sentiment Analytics

alpha_count.zero_alpha: several (primary_sentiment_skewness_2, primary_sentiment_total_2, secondary_sentiment_average, secondary_sentiment_middle_value, secondary_sentiment_minimum, sentiment_score_maximum, sentiment_score_minimum)

crowding: LOW — max alphaCount=10, most fields ac<=7, several ac=0 (anti-crowding law satisfied)
stage1_verdict: VIRGIN sentiment-category dataset; part of news_sentiment family (Sharpe ceiling 3.0+ per CLUSTER mechanism report P1); consistent 0.947 coverage; no vec_* needed for 19 MATRIX fields.

MATRIX: news_article_count (ac=10) — total news articles per entity

design_notes: All MATRIX coverage=0.947 (consistent) → ts_backfill(x,120) for sparse days, no vec_* for MATRIX.
Sentiment scores bounded [0,1] → de-center via ts_zscore (range-invariant, no decimal constant).
ts_rank shift-invariant → safe on raw bounded fields.
Article counts are non-negative → can be weights via rank().
VECTOR fields (news_sentiment_score, *_value) need vec_* wrappers → avoid in Phase 0 (2-3 field law, no vec_* complexity).
Cross-structure: primary vs secondary sentiment = divergence signal; skewness = tail risk; article count x sentiment = conviction weighting.
